audit_notes_not_execution_log: This field is reasoning, not an execution log; the commands above were run in this session and their outputs are quoted. Judgements recorded rather than filed: (1) the named args in composer.status.loop_progress_of_turns are reordered ({total} में से {completed}) — required by Hindi postpositional order, names/types/styles identical, ICU arms unchanged; (2) question_dock.hint.approval paraphrases the two buttons ('स्वीकृति दें या अस्वीकार करें') instead of quoting the client's literal English labels from APPROVAL_OPTIONS — accepted, because the literal answer tokens yes/no/1/2 and Escape are kept byte-identical and the paraphrase is the only Hindi guidance a reader who cannot read the English labels gets; (3) mermaid.unexpected_error now ends in a danda where en has no stop — the round-1 fix, and the joined sentence ('…त्रुटि हुई। त्रुटि डायग्राम कंपोनेंट तक ही रही।') reads correctly; the missing English stop is a source defect, not a hi one; (4) chip.attention's subject-less '# को ध्यान चाहिए' mirrors the source's own subject-less clause and is understood in its tooltip context; (5) run_details.subagents_of 'उप-एजेंट — मूल एजेंट' is the round-1 auditor's own suggestion and composes correctly as a shrink-0 prefix before the owner name; (6) `todos.hidden` (header) passes a formatNumber() string while `todos.hidden_summary` (list) uses ::group-off, so at >=1000 the two counts also differ in grouping — the same divergence exists in English, so it is reported as a source observation, not a hi finding. (7) 'साइन-इन' vs 'साइन इन' hyphenation was checked and accepted: the wider hi corpus uses both spellings in attributive position ('साइन-इन तरीका' but also 'साइन इन पेज', 'साइन इन पूरा'), so mcp.grant.failed / mcp.grant.cancelled are variance rather than a rule violation — no finding.

findings.current: …मॉडल एजेंटिक AI के लिए ज़रूरी जटिल निर्देश नहीं निभा पाता।
findings.problem: 'निर्देश निभाना' is not a Hindi collocation: निभाना takes a duty, promise or role (ज़िम्मेदारी / वादा / भूमिका निभाना), while instructions are माने जाते हैं or their पालन किया जाता है. The clause reads as a calque of 'follow the instructions' in the paragraph that explains a failed turn.
findings.suggestion: …मॉडल एजेंटिक AI के लिए ज़रूरी जटिल निर्देश मान नहीं पाता। (or '…निर्देशों का पालन नहीं कर पाता।')
